Geometric, not numeric: the octant-fold twiddle path was proven bit-exact exhaustively (N=64 and N=128) before quarantining.
notes: QUARANTINE (needs_human) at the FIT CHECK, before any block code was authored -- the outcome the dispatch explicitly legitimized. ZERO doomed build time spent: ~1h of arithmetic + collateral replaced a multi-day unroutable build. The guard test FLIPS if MAX_CELLS_ACROSS or SAMPLES_PER_CELL grow = the un-quarantine signal.
